## Why

What problem does this solve? Link the issue or describe the user impact.

## Change

Describe the resulting behavior and any deliberate trade-offs.

## Evidence

List the checks actually run and their results. For UI changes, add a screenshot
when useful. For a bug fix, show how the original failure is covered.

## Rollout and risk

Describe compatibility, permissions, data changes, cost, and rollback where
relevant. Write "No operational change" for documentation-only changes.

- [ ] Tests and documentation match the change, or the reason they do not is explained.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or confidential fixtures were added.
